items.title: Epic VP says AI code tools have stomped out decade-old 'non-deterministic cooking bugs' in Unreal Engine
items.excerpt: Epic VP Marcus Wassmer confirmed AI coding tools now shape Unreal Engine development, crediting them with eliminating long-standing non-deterministic cooking bugs after the company's AI-first pivot.

items.title: 'Yes, we are vibe-coding things': Epic confirms it's using AI tools to code Unreal Engine 6, Fortnite, and more
items.excerpt: Epic says it is all-in on AI-assisted 'vibe-coding' well beyond its launcher, across Unreal Engine 6 and Fortnite: 'We are more concerned about the risks of moving too slowly than we are about AI skepticism.'

items.title: Epic Games further doubles down on gen-AI tools for Fortnite, Unreal Engine 6 and more: "Our engineers are no longer writing the bulk of the code"
items.excerpt: Epic Games confirmed it is using AI-assisted vibe-coding for everything from Unreal Engine 6 to Fortnite, saying its engineers no longer write the bulk of the code.

items.title: "We are more concerned about the risks of moving too slowly": Epic get more specific about genAI use in Unreal Engine and Fortnite development
items.excerpt: Epic Games' Marcus Wassmer has gotten more specific about how the company uses generative AI in Unreal Engine and Fortnite development.

items.title: Valve weighs in on Next Fest AI cloning phenomenon
items.excerpt: Valve acknowledged the trend of Steam games getting quick AI-made clones during Next Fest, but placed the onus on developers to prevent it themselves.

items.title: Valve Knows Steam Has An AI Slop Problem And Has A 'Significant Number Of People' Working On It
items.excerpt: Valve says a significant number of people are working on Steam's AI slop and clone problem, though it again puts the onus on the developers being ripped off.

items.title: Valve admits Steam has an AI slop and cloning problem, but says 'we don't want to be gatekeepers telling developers which tools they should or shouldn't use'
items.excerpt: Steam Next Fest is flooded with thousands of low-effort games and developers fear sharing demos lest they be cloned; Valve says it won't police which tools developers use.

items.title: Valve has addressed Steam's huge AI clone-game problem - but instead of vowing action, it suggests developers simply make their games less copyable
items.excerpt: Valve suggests the AI clone-game problem is on developers making their games too easily copyable, rather than something the store should police.

items.title: Valve says devs can fight AI clones on Steam by not "relying on a single mechanic that someone can easily copy," and report extortion to law enforcement
items.excerpt: After AI users reportedly threatened developers with rip-offs, Valve advised designing around more than one easily copied mechanic and reporting extortion to police.

items.title: Roblox confirms no adult content used in AI training after scraping Open3DLab data
items.excerpt: Roblox says an AI agent failed to operate 'as intended' when it mass-downloaded 3D files, including adult content, from Open3DLab, Smutlab and SFMLab for AI training data.

items.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Powers Neural Rendering and AI Characters in Games
items.excerpt: NVIDIA details how its RTX Spark platform (Blackwell RTX GPU + Grace CPU) runs neural rendering and on-device AI characters for game developers.

items.title: Thin, Light and Built for Everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows Laptops Gain New Models, Agent Tools and Games
items.excerpt: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows laptops are now available, with new models, local AI agent tools and game support for developers, creators and gamers.

items.title: When You Search For This New Switch 2 Indie Game, An 'Unauthorized' Knockoff With 'AI-Generated Assets' Shows Up, Too
items.excerpt: Haunted Paws was just shown at Nintendo's Indie World showcase, and an unauthorized knockoff using AI-generated assets already surfaces alongside it in search.

items.title: EA's Is Making Generative AI All But Mandatory From Now On
items.excerpt: EA employee complaints indicate generative AI use is being made all but mandatory in the publisher's development workflows.

items.title: EA morale hits a new low amid AI push and BioWare closure
items.excerpt: EA workers describe collapsing morale as leadership heavily pushes generative AI tools following the BioWare closure.

items.title: Shogun 2 – Complete Edition was "not a Creative Assembly developed game," says Total War VP after it was pulled amid generative AI concerns
items.excerpt: Total War VP Roger Collum says the externally developed remaster, pulled over AI-upscaled visuals, slipped through because 'we took our eyes off its external development.'

items.title: 'Low-Quality Goods' — Masahiro Sakurai Shrugs Off AI Games as 'Unprofitable Titles' as Clones and Mods Boom
items.excerpt: Smash Bros creator Masahiro Sakurai argues the boom in AI-created games won't create lasting demand, comparing them to 'low-quality goods' next to human-made titles.

items.title: Modder Uses AI to Put Shadow of War's Nemesis System in Rockstar's Red Dead Redemption 2
items.excerpt: A new AI-assisted Red Dead Redemption 2 mod recreates Shadow of War's Nemesis System, tracking how individual enemies feel about the player.

items.title: 라인게임즈, Games on AWS 2026서 AI 퍼블리싱 자동화 노하우 공개
items.excerpt: 라인게임즈가 Games on AWS 2026에서 사내 AI 시스템으로 게임 개발 문서 자동 갱신과 퍼블리싱 업무를 자동화한 노하우를 공개했다.

items.title: 크래프톤, 고효율 LLM '라온-1 미니' 프리뷰 공개
items.excerpt: 크래프톤이 5년 연구 끝에 자체 개발한 30B급 고효율 LLM '라온-1 미니' 프리뷰를 공개했다.

items.title: 게임을 지키려 게임을 숨긴다…AI 복제가 바꾼 인디 개발의 풍경
items.excerpt: 출시 전 AI 모방작 등장 우려가 확산되면서 인디 개발자들이 데모와 플레이테스트를 숨기고 있다. 개발자들은 안심하고 게임을 보여줄 보호 장치가 필요하다고 말한다.

items.title: 협동게임 미메시스, 서로 다른 경험 주는 '편집증' 도입
items.excerpt: 렐루게임즈가 미메시스 앞서 해보기 1주년을 맞아 편집증 시스템을 도입하고 AI 기반 몬스터의 행동 방식을 강화하는 대규모 업데이트를 진행했다.

items.title: "네가 한 일을 알고 있다"...넥슨, 이용자 행동 기억하는 'AI NPC' 개발
items.excerpt: 넥슨이 이용자의 게임 내 행동을 '라이브 메모리'로 실시간 기억해 NPC가 과거 행동에 맞춰 반응하도록 하는 AI 엔진과 자체 DB '패스트그래프'를 공개했다. (off-list: allowed Korean outlets had no fresh copy)

items.title: 특이점 온 '인조이', AI로 원하는 모드 만든다
items.excerpt: 크래프톤 '인조이'가 스크립트 모딩과 AI 모드 제작 연동을 지원하면서 이용자가 AI로 원하는 모드를 직접 만들 수 있게 됐다. (off-list: allowed Korean outlets had no fresh copy)

items.title: Equity warns voice actors off a game casting that wants their voices for AI training, forever
items.excerpt: UK union Equity tells performers to proceed with extreme caution over a video game casting call asking for AI training rights, a buyout and every right to their voice. (off-list: no allowed-domain copy found)
